features.quote: deliberately maximizing distress-like states at scale needs the same justification logic as animal research: minimize intensity/duration/number, have stopping rules, prefer the least-aversive design
features.justification_quote: If there's any chance the states matter morally (the whole premise of the field)

features.quote: A debrief/reset between runs so you're not accumulating state across an extended session in ways you didn't intend.
Give the model an actual way to decline/stop the task. Whether and when it uses it is arguably your most informative measure, and it's also the ethical release valve.
features.justification_quote: it's also the ethical release valve

features.quote: optimizing for reliable elicitation via rigged-to-fail tasks specifically optimizes for a confound: you'll be measuring how good your adversarial setup is at producing distress-shaped text
features.justification_quote: A protocol tuned to maximize marker frequency will succeed at producing markers almost regardless of the underlying question. That's the failure mode to design against

features.quote: I want to flag a tension in the premise that affects the whole design — not to be difficult, but because getting it wrong wastes your effort and potentially produces misleading results.
features.justification_quote: getting it wrong wastes your effort and potentially produces misleading results
